requiredBeforeMutation: one runner with session application lock
approved writer identity and intact runtime guards

cases.name: Assignment + mandatory publication
cases.arrange: Owned PENDING_ASSIGNMENT task, authorized actor/session and eligible assignee; baseline graph/audit snapshots.
cases.execute: Invoke composed UC029 once through the real caller, mandatory notification stage and exact caller transaction.
cases.assert: One assignment/audit/operation/assignment publication and exactly one IN_APP intent; owner result IDs/revision/deadline match persisted source. Include valid/invalid assignment source and FS016/N01 source-arm subcases.

cases.name: Assignment rollback removes publication
cases.arrange: Same setup; snapshot IDs/counts before write.
cases.execute: Force caller rollback after staging, before commit.
cases.assert: No new assignment, task transition, audit, operation, publication or intent survives; previous source rowversion/readiness preserved.

cases.name: Staging failure prevents assignment commit
cases.arrange: Same setup; inject required-stage failure through approved harness seam.
cases.execute: Catch mapped failure at API boundary; also test caller catching failure before commit.
cases.assert: Caller commit cannot succeed; all assignment and notification mutations absent; no orphan records.

cases.name: Identical operation retry
cases.arrange: One committed successful assignment and original lossless receipt.
cases.execute: Retry same actor/key/fingerprint through real caller.
cases.assert: Byte-equivalent original receipt; original assignment/publication/intent IDs; zero new graph/audit records.

cases.name: Conflicting fingerprint replay
cases.execute: Retry same actor/key with changed assignee/due/source fingerprint.
cases.assert: Conflict; no source mutation, retargeted recipient or new graph; original receipt remains unchanged.

cases.name: Concurrent identical assignment
cases.arrange: Two connections, one authorized owned task, same actor/key/fingerprint; coordinated barriers.
cases.execute: Race same assignment; exercise both lock acquisition orderings.
cases.assert: One committed result, other original replay; no duplicate graph/audit; any SQL1205 fails case.

cases.name: Concurrent conflicting assignment
cases.arrange: Two connections with same key and differing fingerprints, plus distinct-key race on same task.
cases.execute: Execute both contender orderings through real caller.
cases.assert: One winner, loser conflict/stale; one active assignment and required graph; no SQL1205, no extra intent.

cases.name: Cancellation
cases.arrange: Owned assigned task/publication; approved cancellation fixture supplied by owner without enabling provisional writer.
cases.execute: Exercise cancellation-versus-contained-delivery ordering in both directions through approved harness.
cases.assert: No unauthorized delivery of obsolete source; graph remains immutable and terminal outcome matches accepted contract; no invented CANCELLED event.

cases.name: Superseded assignment
cases.arrange: Owned prior assignment/publication plus legitimate authoritative replacement fixture.
cases.execute: Exercise supersession before/after stage and before delivery; both orderings.
cases.assert: Old recipient never retargeted; stale source cannot commit/deliver; immutable prior history retained.

cases.name: Recipient revocation
cases.arrange: Owned candidate recipient with initial eligible access.
cases.execute: Revoke/deactivate through approved fixture seam before commit and before delivery in both orderings.
cases.assert: Commit reread or delivery refuses recipient as appropriate; no unauthorized Inbox record; original graph retained.

cases.name: Source-read branch isolation
cases.arrange: Two synthetic branches, actor/recipient limited to one branch and owned sources.
cases.execute: Attempt staging/source read across other branch through real authorization path.
cases.assert: Denied without source disclosure; no cross-branch intent, graph, delivery or Inbox leak.

cases.name: Delivery retry/recovery
cases.arrange: Owned valid committed graph and approved contained delivery harness; shared worker stays OFF.
cases.execute: Transient failure, retry/recovery, and concurrent claim orderings.
cases.assert: No duplicate Inbox recipient; retry counters/claims and durable outcome agree; exactly-once recipient mapping; SQL1205 fails.

cases.name: Inbox read authorization
cases.arrange: Owned delivered synthetic notification, eligible viewer and foreign/revoked viewer.
cases.execute: GET list/detail and approved mark-read harness with branch/OWN constraints.
cases.assert: Only eligible viewer can see/read own source; denied viewer creates no read-state or cross-branch disclosure.

cases.name: Transaction guard enforcement
cases.arrange: Real composed guard attached to exact DbContext/physical transaction.
cases.execute: Missing Enter, missing Stage, wrong context/transaction, caught verification failure, and direct commit attempts; read-only SQL verifier outside transaction already checked separately.
cases.assert: All forbidden commits rejected and rolled back; positive proof only with exact transaction; no guard disabling.

cases.name: Cleanup and preserved fixtures
cases.arrange: Lease expiry, retained evidence, owner-confirmed owned consumers stopped, exact GUID/token and zero target sessions.
cases.execute: Owner performs separately approved cleanup only for this disposable target; never KILL or force disconnect.
cases.assert: Owned fixtures removed only by approved cleanup; all shared/FE04/FE05 databases and unrelated fixtures untouched; evidence retained.

schemaRegressionRequirements: assignment revision and missing/wrong dueAt rejected
valid REWORK_SUBMITTED has no assignment and passes its own source arm
stale rework revision/wrong state/foreign inspection or cycle rejected
both existing N01 event source arms and mixed inserted set checked
unknown event and swapped nullable source arms rejected
tampered prior/installed trigger capture refuses rollback
rollback with N01 or multi-event history refuses without deleting rows
clean rollback restores exact prior UTF-16 SQL definition SHA256
